title: Dev-ResNet: automated developmental event detection using deep learning
summary: Dev-ResNet detected embryonic developmental events from time-lapse imaging and supported a measured finding about temperature-associated shifts in event timing. The result is limited to the reported samples, datasets, and assays; broader transfer and downstream utility were not established.
